$comment: Generated-asset manifest for Astra. Written by prototype/tools/assets/gen_assets.mjs and read by contact_sheet.mjs. Status is the gate: only Sangram moves an entry to 'approved', and only 'approved' assets may be referenced by the app. Claude never self-approves generated art.

schema.id: string — stable asset id, lowercase (e.g. 'mesha'). Matches the key in prompts.json.
schema.kind: 'rashi' | 'graha' — rashis are translucent starlight sculpture; grahas are dimensional bodies. See style bible §8.
schema.usage: string[] — where the asset is used: 'sky-art' (the sky/universe scene), 'hero' (detail sheets, 300px+), 'chart' (kundali occupants and inline icons, 18–96px).
schema.size: string — master render size, always '1024x1024'. Ship sizes are downscaled at build time.
schema.transparent: boolean — always true. A non-transparent background pixel is an automatic rejection (criterion 5).
schema.lightDark: 'both' — every asset must survive night indigo #1B1F3C, day sky #7A9AD0 and reading page #F7F5EF. See style bible §3.2.
schema.frameFill: number — fraction of the frame the form must occupy, matched to the measured constants in prototype/src/celestial-art.js. Missing it silently mis-scales the asset at every call site.
schema.promptVersion: string — the prompts.json version this asset was generated from. Never ship a batch with mixed promptVersions.
schema.prompt: string | null — the exact full prompt sent to the model, filled in at generation time. Null until generated.
schema.model: string | null — the model id actually chosen by gen_assets.mjs at generation time. Null until generated.
schema.generatedAt: string | null — ISO 8601 timestamp of generation. Null until generated.
schema.file: string | null — filename relative to prototype/assets/gen/, as '<id>-<variant>.png'. Null until generated.
schema.status: 'planned' | 'pending-review' | 'approved' | 'rejected' — 'planned' means no prompt or no render yet; 'pending-review' is set automatically on generation; 'approved' and 'rejected' are set by Sangram only, after the contact sheet.
schema.notes: string — review notes, the rejection criterion that was hit, or the constraint that governs this asset.

assets.notes: Style test 1 of 5 — tests animal form. Reading gesture is the horn spiral; it must survive the 96px silhouette test.
Style test 2 of 5 — tests human figures. A couple (man with mace, woman with vina), not twins and not the Gemini glyph. Iconography needs practitioner confirmation before approval.
Style test 3 of 5 — tests human figure with an object. Variant A is the classical horse-bodied archer; variant B the simplified standing archer. Sangram picks; a practitioner confirms.

Style test 4 of 5 — tests a dimensional body with rings. OPEN CONFLICT (style bible §6.2): baked shaded rings contradict the shipped procedural ring renderer in celestial-art.js, which samples only the globe at 0.477 so rings can have real depth ordering. Decide and record in docs/decisions/ before this moves to approved.
Style test 5 of 5 — tests the node language: crescent, shadow, ascending direction. Never a sphere. Take the head and the serpent's line, leave the gore. Must read as Ketu's opposite.
